actual_problem: QIF can declare an activation or rollback path but cannot reconcile the declared action with observed execution, prove recovery completion, or govern promotion of the policy state.
why_it_matters: A policy may be promoted after a declared but unexecuted activation, incomplete rollback, stale observation, or state mismatch, creating false assurance and rewriting apparent operational truth.
why_now: QIF v0.8.7 completed the authority-observation-rollback contract; current agent operations guidance separates evaluate-only from enforce mode and requires promotion criteria, deployment outcome tracking, and tested rollback confirmation.
